content: Rey Miguel is a premium, hand-crafted cigar brand owned by Black Cat Cigar Co., based in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The brand was developed by José Pepin Garcia, a renowned figure in the cigar industry, and is produced at the El Rey de los Habanos factory, located in the Little Havana neighborhood of Miami, Florida. This cigar is classified as medium-bodied. Its filler consists of a carefully blended selection of Nicaraguan tobaccos. The binder used in its construction remains undisclosed. The wrapper is a Connecticut-seed variety, cultivated in Ecuador by Silvio and Alfredo Perez. This specific wrapper is known to moderate the strength and body of the Nicaraguan filler blend, creating a balanced smoking experience. Further details about the Perez family and their contributions to the cigar industry can be found in a profile published by Cigar Aficionado.
